author: Rubikscrafter
body:
I realized that people that have been on Avicus for a long time have been leaving, like Endsy and Jkawesome/Hacktivism.

I just want to say that those people are making a hard decision, leaving this amazing server. 

I just want us to remember those people always in our minds. And in our hearts.

















A Wise Man Once Said:

Long Live Avicus, And Its Awesome Players
